verdict: Both papers reproduce (arxiv:1509.03580: reproduced_under_assumptions, arxiv:2009.08810: reproduced_under_assumptions). Moving the recovering paper's noise placement to the failing paper's value drops recovery from 1.00 to 0.00. This matches the hand-checked answer (noise placement).

fix.summary: On arxiv:2009.08810's setup, smoothed-ensemble-sindy (threshold 0.5) cuts coefficient error from 0.69 (best standard SINDy, sindy (threshold 0.5)) to 0.19, and still misses some Lorenz terms. It beats standard SINDy on 3 of 3 unseen trajectories. Tied within seed noise: smoothed-ensemble-sindy (threshold 0.2).
